mapper.insert: insert into knowledge_base(user_id, name, type, created_at, updated_at) values (#{userId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: select exists(select 1 from knowledge_base where id = #{knowledgeBaseId} and user_id = #{userId})
select count(*) from knowledge_base where user_id = #{userId}
select id, user_id, name, type, created_at, updated_at from knowledge_base where user_id = #{userId} limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}
